articles.summary: Singapore's Energy Market Authority awarded Posh Electric a grant to deploy a 1MWh sodium-ion battery energy storage system — integrating 600 kW of rooftop solar with A*STAR's IMRE and Utraco — validating the chemistry-agnostic battery intelligence behind every Posh deployment.
articles.title: Posh Electric Awarded Singapore EMA Grant for 1MWh Sodium-ion Battery Trial
